risks.risk: The tread depth may be significantly below the 40mm legal limit for safety.
risks.proof: A photo of the tread depth with a ruler or a depth gauge.

risks.risk: The tire may have hidden damage, cracks, or bead issues not visible in the close-up.
risks.proof: A photo of the entire tire with the sidewalls and all sides visible.

proof_requests: Photo of the sidewall showing the size and the manufacturing date code.
Photo of the tread depth with a ruler or a depth gauge.
Photo of the entire tire showing the sidewalls and all sides.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
